resources.string: Merges Wi-Fi, mobile signal and battery into a single iPhone-Duo style trio glyph in the status bar.
Master switch. Turning it off hides the trio icon this module draws; the stock icons are untouched.

Which arrangement to draw. The ring is the default; the rectangular one puts a column of signal dots on each side of the centre and a battery bar across the bottom; the capsule makes the outline itself the battery bar, keeps the time in a fixed left column, shows one reading on the right by priority (charging, Wi-Fi, percentage, network type) and rides the signal dots on the outline\'s top and bottom edges.

Stops the status bar window height from clipping the trio icon. Turn off to draw inside the bar again. It is also the gate for the trio size: only with it on can the size reach 100-130%; with it off the maximum is 100%.
Draws the Wi-Fi arcs, the number of arcs following the actual signal strength; hidden when off.
Draws four level dots at the bottom for the mobile signal strength; hidden when off.
With no Wi-Fi and not charging, draws two rows of signal dots: SIM 1 on top, SIM 2 below. Only applies to dual-SIM; single-SIM or charging still shows one row for the active data SIM.
Shows the battery percentage inside the ring; a bolt replaces it while charging. Hidden when off.
When off, the in-ring bolt icon is not drawn.
Where the network type label goes: off, inside the ring, or drawn separately outside the ring.
Where the mobile signal reading goes: dots at the bottom of the ring, or drawn separately outside the ring.
Style switch for the out-of-ring reading: on stacks both SIMs, off shows them separately.
With dual SIM, only the active data SIM reading is shown; the other card is hidden. No effect on single-SIM or when the data SIM cannot be read.
Overall height of the out-of-ring reading. Default 15dp; range 6-20dp.
Gap between the out-of-ring signal reading and the battery icon. Default 2dp, range 0-16dp.
Moves the whole trio icon left or right. 0 = default position; adjusts the trio icon right margin.
Draws the battery level next to the bolt while charging. Hidden = default; On ring = in the charging notch; In ring = in the middle of the ring.
On = the signal icon also goes into the charging notch and lines up with the bolt; Off = the signal is hidden. Requires \"Centre the level\".
Size of the bolt-plus-level pair. Default 30, range 30-35.
Size of the bolt-plus-signal pair. Default 30, range 30-35.
Applies only when the pair shows 5GA: size of the trailing "A" as a percentage of the main size. Default 65%, range 50-100%.
Pick \"Bolt\" to show it only while charging.
Hidden, on the ring, inside the ring.
Samsung style has squarer corners (matches S25U).
Default 0, range -30 to 60. Lengthens the straight run between the end caps: the capsule grows wider while the caps and the height stay put.
Distance from the native status bar icons to the trio icon. Default 0, range -8.0 to +8.0dp.
Lets the trio and out-of-ring icons drift within a tiny range so the same pixels are not lit for long stretches. Default on.
How far the icon may drift from its home position, 0.25dp per step. Default 0.50dp; 0 means no movement at all. Larger values protect more, capped at 2dp.
Seconds for one full cycle, default 60. Shorter periods move faster.
Overall size of the trio icon, 60-130%, default 100%. Past 100% the drawing and its reserved space grow together and the icon may overflow the status bar row, in the shade as well.
Overall size of the trio icon, 60-100%, default 100%. To go past 100%, turn on "draw in its own window" first.
Shows the battery temperature next to the battery icon.
Gap between the temperature reading and the neighbour on its left. Default 2dp, range 0-16dp.
Gap between the temperature reading and the trio icon on its right. Default 2dp, range 0-16dp.
Scales the whole reading up or down on top of the automatic font size, 60-150%, default 100%.
Stroke weight of the reading text, range 100-900.
Enlarges the battery level into the middle of the ring, where it always takes priority. The Wi-Fi arcs shrink into the top notch, and while charging a small bolt takes the notch.
Pick colors for low battery, charging and critical battery.
Set the color used when the status bar sits on a dark or a light background.
Restore the three state colors to their factory presets.
All three state colors go back to their factory presets; your custom colors will be overwritten.
When on, the battery ring turns the low-battery yellow while the system is in power save mode. When off, the trio battery colour stays as it is. Default on.
Switch to the low battery color below this percentage.
Stroke width of the battery ring.
Thickness of the battery bar along the bottom.
Stroke width of the Wi-Fi arcs.
Width of the Wi-Fi arc stroke.
Size of the percentage text. With "centre the level" on, the centred digits grow up to 1.4x and stop at 38.
Stroke weight of the battery level, range 100-900.
Font size of the 3G/4G/5G label in the ring centre.
Size of the out-of-ring 3G/4G/5G label in the status bar. Default 14dp, range 8-26dp.
Gap between the out-of-ring signal reading and the 5G label. Default 2dp, range 0-16dp.
Gap between the 5G label and the icon on its right. Default 2dp, range 0-16dp.
When the network type ends in A (5GA), the trailing A as a percentage of the main size. Default 65%, range 50-100%; applies both inside and outside the ring.
Stroke weight of the network type, range 100-900.
Opacity of the unlit parts of the glyph.
Write verbose output to /sdcard/SamsungDuo_debug.log. Enable only when diagnosing.
